citation: "Town of Chicago." Chicagology. Including the town code of 7 November 1833.
note: Town limits fixed 6 November 1833 (Jackson south, Jefferson and Cook west, Ohio north — 'barely seven-eighths of a square mile'), extended 11 February 1835 east to the lake shore and out to Chicago Avenue and Twelfth Street. Also the first code of laws: pigs prohibited from wandering the streets, dead animals prohibited from the river, bridge timber theft penalised — each an ordinance that documents the behaviour it forbids.
